correctness.rationale: The finite unordered deleted-product CW complex has 153/432/297 cells with a checked signed boundary and no higher cells; 270 independent boundary columns modulo 101 bound rational kernel rank above by 27. All 45 hexagon-pair product tori have zero boundary, and 27 have a specified integer coefficient minor of determinant +1, proving their saturated rank-27 subgroup equals the entire integral kernel. All 234 torus vectors are exactly reconstructed in that basis. Exhaustive 216-automorphism orbit calculations and exact integer Smith forms give all index and quotient claims. The standalone artifact computes all asserted certificates and is included as a fully self-contained executable with declared Python dependencies.

value.rationale: The Pappus graph is a canonical symmetric toroidal cubic graph with intrinsically motivated shortest six-cycles. Knowing H_2 rank does not distinguish 18- and 27-element automorphism orbits or whether their geometric classes are primitive/saturated. The theorem proves all 45 shortest-cycle tori generate integrally, while the full-rank 27-member orbit leaves a (Z/2)^5 quotient and the 6,10 length family leaves a genuine Z/4 invariant. These complete natural generator-lattice obstructions make a motivated finite structural classification useful for comparisons with other nonplanar graph-configuration spaces.
